method: Execute exact AST-extracted upstream score() with fixed observed positives and controlled added misses. Compare a zero-addition control to miss interventions.
finding: Same precision coexists with different recall and macro-F1. A positive-hit ledger alone cannot establish missed-positive coverage.
limits: Synthetic sensitivity probe using published aggregate matrices, not newly measured detector performance.
Added 834 misses is a stress value motivated by unresolved-claim count, not an assertion that unresolved claims are misses or share this evaluation denominator.
No new model inference, annotation or scanner execution. Original paper and maintainer historical measurements retain their original dates.
